versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
controles.kjv: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
controles.livre: Depois a palavra do SENHOR veio a mim, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־אָדָ֗ם כֹּה־אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֧י יְהוִ֛ה לְאַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל קֵ֑ץ בָּ֣א הַקֵּ֔ץ עַל־ארבעת כַּנְפ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: You, son of man, thus says the Lord Yahweh to the land of Israel, An end: the end has come on the four corners of the land.
controles.kjv: Also, thou son of man, thus saith the Lord God unto the land of Israel; An end, the end is come upon the four corners of the land.
controles.livre: E tu, filho do homem, assim diz o Senhor DEUS à terra de Israel: É o fim, o fim vem sobre os quatro cantos da terra.

versos.hebraico: עַתָּה֙ הַקֵּ֣ץ עָלַ֔יִךְ וְשִׁלַּחְתִּ֤י אַפִּי֙ בָּ֔ךְ וּשְׁפַטְתִּ֖יךְ כִּדְרָכָ֑יִךְ וְנָתַתִּ֣י עָלַ֔יִךְ אֵ֖ת כָּל־תּוֹעֲבֹתָֽיִךְ׃

controles.web: Now is the end on you, and I will send my anger on you, and will judge you according to your ways; and I will bring on you all your abominations.
controles.kjv: Now is the end come upon thee, and I will send mine anger upon thee, and will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense upon thee all thine abominations.
controles.livre: Agora veio o fim sobre ti; pois enviarei minha ira sobre ti, e te julgarei conforme teus caminhos; e trarei sobre ti todas as tuas abominações.

versos.hebraico: וְלֹא־תָח֥וֹס עֵינִ֛י עָלַ֖יִךְ וְלֹ֣א אֶחְמ֑וֹל כִּ֣י דְרָכַ֜יִךְ עָלַ֣יִךְ אֶתֵּ֗ן וְתוֹעֲבוֹתַ֨יִךְ֙ בְּתוֹכֵ֣ךְ תִּֽהְיֶ֔יןָ וִידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ

controles.web: My eye shall not spare you, neither will I have pity; but I will bring your ways on you, and your abominations shall be in your midst: and you shall know that I am Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And mine eye shall not spare thee, neither will I have pity: but I will recompense thy ways upon thee, and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.
controles.livre: E meu olho não te poupará, nem terei compaixão; ao invés disso trarei teus caminhos sobre ti, e tuas abominações estarão no meio de ti; e sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה רָעָ֛ה אַחַ֥ת רָעָ֖ה הִנֵּ֥ה בָאָֽה׃

controles.web: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: An evil, an only evil; behold, it comes.
controles.kjv: Thus saith the Lord God; An evil, an only evil, behold, is come.
controles.livre: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Uma calamidade,  eis que vem uma calamidade incomparável.

versos.hebraico: קֵ֣ץ בָּ֔א בָּ֥א הַקֵּ֖ץ הֵקִ֣יץ אֵלָ֑יִךְ הִנֵּ֖ה בָּאָֽה׃

controles.web: An end has come, the end has come; it awakes against you; behold, it comes.
controles.kjv: An end is come, the end is come: it watcheth for thee; behold, it is come.
controles.livre: Vem o fim, o fim vem; despertou-se contra ti; eis que vem.

versos.hebraico: בָּ֧אָה הַצְּפִירָ֛ה אֵלֶ֖יךָ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב הָאָ֑רֶץ בָּ֣א הָעֵ֗ת קָר֛וֹב הַיּ֥וֹם מְהוּמָ֖ה וְלֹא־הֵ֥ד הָרִֽים׃

controles.web: Your doom has come to you, inhabitant of the land: the time has come, the day is near, a day of tumult, and not of joyful shouting, on the mountains.
controles.kjv: The morning is come unto thee, O thou that dwellest in the land: the time is come, the day of trouble is near, and not the sounding again of the mountains.
controles.livre: A manhã vem para ti, ó morador da terra; o tempo vem, chegado é o dia em que haverá desespero, e não gritos de alegria sobre os montes.

versos.hebraico: עַתָּ֣ה מִקָּר֗וֹב אֶשְׁפּ֤וֹךְ חֲמָתִי֙ עָלַ֔יִךְ וְכִלֵּיתִ֤י אַפִּי֙ בָּ֔ךְ וּשְׁפַטְתִּ֖יךְ כִּדְרָכָ֑יִךְ וְנָתַתִּ֣י עָלַ֔יִךְ אֵ֖ת כָּל־תּוֹעֲבוֹתָֽיִךְ׃

controles.web: Now will I shortly pour out my wrath on you, and accomplish my anger against you, and will judge you according to your ways; and I will bring on you all your abominations.
controles.kjv: Now will I shortly pour out my fury upon thee, and accomplish mine anger upon thee: and I will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense thee for all thine abominations.
controles.livre: Agora logo derramarei meu furor sobre ti, cumprirei minha ira contra ti; e te julgarei conforme teus caminhos; e porei sobre ti todas as tuas abominações.

versos.hebraico: וְלֹא־תָח֥וֹס עֵינִ֖י וְלֹ֣א אֶחְמ֑וֹל כִּדְרָכַ֜יִךְ עָלַ֣יִךְ אֶתֵּ֗ן וְתוֹעֲבוֹתַ֨יִךְ֙ בְּתוֹכֵ֣ךְ תִּֽהְיֶ֔יןָ וִֽידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מַכֶּֽה׃

controles.web: My eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: I will bring on you according to your ways; and your abominations shall be in your midst; and you shall know that I, Yahweh, do strike.
controles.kjv: And mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: I will recompense thee according to thy ways and thine abominations that are in the midst of thee; and ye shall know that I am the Lord that smiteth.
controles.livre: E meu olho não poupará, nem terei compaixão; trarei sobre ti conforme teus caminhos, e no meio de ti estarão tuas abominações; e sabereis que eu, o SENHOR, sou o que firo.

versos.hebraico: הִנֵּ֥ה הַיּ֖וֹם הִנֵּ֣ה בָאָ֑ה יָֽצְאָה֙ הַצְּפִרָ֔ה צָ֚ץ הַמַּטֶּ֔ה פָּרַ֖ח הַזָּדֽוֹן׃

controles.web: Behold, the day, behold, it comes: your doom has gone out; the rod has blossomed, pride has budded.
controles.kjv: Behold the day, behold, it is come: the morning is gone forth; the rod hath blossomed, pride hath budded.
controles.livre: Eis aqui o dia, eis que vem; a manhã já saiu; já floresceu a vara, a soberba já gerou brotos.

versos.hebraico: הֶחָמָ֥ס׀ קָ֖ם לְמַטֵּה־רֶ֑שַׁע לֹא־מֵהֶ֞ם וְלֹ֧א מֵהֲמוֹנָ֛ם וְלֹ֥א מֶהֱמֵהֶ֖ם וְלֹא־נֹ֥הַּ בָּהֶֽם׃

controles.web: Violence has risen up into a rod of wickedness. None of them shall remain, nor of their multitude, nor of their wealth. There shall be nothing of value among them.
controles.kjv: Violence is risen up into a rod of wickedness: none of them shall remain, nor of their multitude, nor of any of theirs: neither shall there be wailing for them.
controles.livre: A violência se levantou em vara de maldade; nada restará deles, nem de sua multidão, nem de sua riqueza,  nem de seu prestígio.

versos.hebraico: בָּ֤א הָעֵת֙ הִגִּ֣יעַ הַיּ֔וֹם הַקּוֹנֶה֙ אַל־יִשְׂמָ֔ח וְהַמּוֹכֵ֖ר אַל־יִתְאַבָּ֑ל כִּ֥י חָר֖וֹן אֶל־כָּל־הֲמוֹנָֽהּ׃

controles.web: The time has come, the day draws near: don’t let the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn; for wrath is on all its multitude.
controles.kjv: The time is come, the day draweth near: let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn: for wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.
controles.livre: O tempo veio, achegou-se o dia; o comprador não se alegre, nem o vendedor entristeça; porque a ira está sobre toda sua multidão.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י הַמּוֹכֵ֗ר אֶל־הַמִּמְכָּר֙ לֹ֣א יָשׁ֔וּב וְע֥וֹד בַּחַיִּ֖ים חַיָּתָ֑ם כִּֽי־חָז֤וֹן אֶל־כָּל־הֲמוֹנָהּ֙ לֹ֣א יָשׁ֔וּב וְאִ֧ישׁ בַּעֲוֺנ֛וֹ חַיָּת֖וֹ לֹ֥א יִתְחַזָּֽקוּ׃

controles.web: For the seller shall not return to that which is sold, although they be yet alive: for the vision is touching the whole multitude of it, none shall return; neither shall any strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.
controles.kjv: For the seller shall not return to that which is sold, although they were yet alive: for the vision is touching the whole multitude thereof, which shall not return; neither shall any strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.
controles.livre: Pois o vendedor não voltará ao que foi vendido, enquanto estiverem vivos; porque a visão sobre toda sua multidão não será cancelada; e por causa de sua iniquidade, ninguém poderá preservar sua vida.

versos.hebraico: תָּקְע֤וּ בַתָּק֨וֹעַ֙ וְהָכִ֣ין הַכֹּ֔ל וְאֵ֥ין הֹלֵ֖ךְ לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה כִּ֥י חֲרוֹנִ֖י אֶל־כָּל־הֲמוֹנָֽהּ׃

controles.web: They have blown the trumpet, and have made all ready; but no one goes to the battle; for my wrath is on all its multitude.
controles.kjv: They have blown the trumpet, even to make all ready; but none goeth to the battle: for my wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.
controles.livre: Já tocaram trombeta, e prepararam tudo; porém ninguém vai à batalha, pois minha ira está sobre toda sua multidão.

versos.hebraico: הַחֶ֣רֶב בַּח֔וּץ וְהַדֶּ֥בֶר וְהָרָעָ֖ב מִבָּ֑יִת אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּשָּׂדֶה֙ בַּחֶ֣רֶב יָמ֔וּת וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּעִ֔יר רָעָ֥ב וָדֶ֖בֶר יֹאכֲלֶֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: The sword is outside, and the pestilence and the famine within: he who is in the field shall die with the sword: and he who is in the city, famine and pestilence shall devour him.
controles.kjv: The sword is without, and the pestilence and the famine within: he that is in the field shall die with the sword; and he that is in the city, famine and pestilence shall devour him.
controles.livre: Por fora a espada, por dentro a pestilência e a fome; o que estiver no campo morrerá à espada; e o que estiver na cidade, a fome e a pestilência o consumirão.

versos.hebraico: וּפָֽלְטוּ֙ פְּלִ֣יטֵיהֶ֔ם וְהָי֣וּ אֶל־הֶהָרִ֗ים כְּיוֹנֵ֧י הַגֵּאָי֛וֹת כֻּלָּ֖ם הֹמ֑וֹת אִ֖ישׁ בַּעֲוֺנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: But those of those who escape shall escape, and shall be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them moaning, every one in his iniquity.
controles.kjv: But they that escape of them shall escape, and shall be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them mourning, every one for his iniquity.
controles.livre: E os sobreviventes que deles escaparem  estarão pelos montes como pombas dos vales, todos gemendo, cada um por sua maldade.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־הַיָּדַ֖יִם תִּרְפֶּ֑ינָה וְכָל־בִּרְכַּ֖יִם תֵּלַ֥כְנָה מָּֽיִם׃

controles.web: All hands shall be feeble, and all knees shall be weak as water.
controles.kjv: All hands shall be feeble, and all knees shall be weak as water.
controles.livre: Todas mãos serão fracas, e todos joelhos serão frouxos como águas.

versos.hebraico: וְחָגְר֣וּ שַׂקִּ֔ים וְכִסְּתָ֥ה אוֹתָ֖ם פַּלָּצ֑וּת וְאֶ֤ל כָּל־פָּנִים֙ בּוּשָׁ֔ה וּבְכָל־רָאשֵׁיהֶ֖ם קָרְחָֽה׃

controles.web: They shall also clothe themselves with sackcloth, and horror shall cover them; and shame shall be on all faces, and baldness on all their heads.
controles.kjv: They shall also gird themselves with sackcloth, and horror shall cover them; and shame shall be upon all faces, and baldness upon all their heads.
controles.livre: E se vestirão de saco, e o tremor os cobrirá; em todos os rostos haverá vergonha, e todas as suas cabeças serão raspadas.

versos.hebraico: כַּסְפָּ֞ם בַּחוּצ֣וֹת יַשְׁלִ֗יכוּ וּזְהָבָם֮ לְנִדָּ֣ה יִֽהְיֶה֒ כַּסְפָּ֨ם וּזְהָבָ֜ם לֹֽא־יוּכַ֣ל לְהַצִּילָ֗ם בְּיוֹם֙ עֶבְרַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה נַפְשָׁם֙ לֹ֣א יְשַׂבֵּ֔עוּ וּמֵעֵיהֶ֖ם לֹ֣א יְמַלֵּ֑אוּ כִּֽי־מִכְשׁ֥וֹל עֲוֺנָ֖ם הָיָֽה׃

controles.web: They shall cast their silver in the streets, and their gold shall be as an unclean thing; their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of Yahweh: they shall not satisfy their souls, neither fill their bowels; because it has been the stumbling block of their iniquity.
controles.kjv: They shall cast their silver in the streets, and their gold shall be removed: their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of the Lord: they shall not satisfy their souls, neither fill their bowels: because it is the stumblingblock of their iniquity.
controles.livre: Lançarão sua prata pelas ruas, e seu ouro será como algo imundo; nem sua prata nem seu ouro poderá livrá-los no dia do furor do SENHOR; não saciarão suas almas, nem encherão suas entranhas; pois isto é o tropeço de sua maldade.

versos.hebraico: וּצְבִ֤י עֶדְיוֹ֙ לְגָא֣וֹן שָׂמָ֔הוּ וְצַלְמֵ֧י תוֹעֲבֹתָ֛ם שִׁקּוּצֵיהֶ֖ם עָ֣שׂוּ ב֑וֹ עַל־כֵּ֛ן נְתַתִּ֥יו לָהֶ֖ם לְנִדָּֽה׃

controles.web: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty; but they made the images of their abominations and their detestable things therein: therefore have I made it to them as an unclean thing.
controles.kjv: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty: but they made the images of their abominations and of their detestable things therein: therefore have I set it far from them.
controles.livre: E tornaram a glória de seu ornamento em orgulho, e nela fizeram nela imagens de suas abominações e de suas coisas detestáveis; por isso eu a tornarei em coisa imunda para eles;

versos.hebraico: וּנְתַתִּ֤יו בְּיַֽד־הַזָּרִים֙ לָבַ֔ז וּלְרִשְׁעֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ לְשָׁלָ֑ל וחללה׃

controles.web: I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a plunder; and they shall profane it.
controles.kjv: And I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil; and they shall pollute it.
controles.livre: E a entregarei em mãos de estrangeiros para ser saqueada, e aos perversos da terra para servir de despojo; e a profanarão.

versos.hebraico: וַהֲסִבּוֹתִ֤י פָנַי֙ מֵהֶ֔ם וְחִלְּל֖וּ אֶת־צְפוּנִ֑י וּבָאוּ־בָ֥הּ פָּרִיצִ֖ים וְחִלְּלֽוּהָ׃פ

controles.web: My face will I turn also from them, and they shall profane my secret place; and robbers shall enter into it, and profane it.
controles.kjv: My face will I turn also from them, and they shall pollute my secret place: for the robbers shall enter into it, and defile it.
controles.livre: E desviarei meu rosto deles, e profanarão meu lugar secreto; pois nele entrarão destruidores, e o profanarão.

versos.hebraico: עֲשֵׂ֖ה הָֽרַתּ֑וֹק כִּ֣י הָאָ֗רֶץ מָֽלְאָה֙ מִשְׁפַּ֣ט דָּמִ֔ים וְהָעִ֖יר מָלְאָ֥ה חָמָֽס׃

controles.web: Make the chain; for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.
controles.kjv: Make a chain: for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.
controles.livre: Faze correntes,  porque a terra está cheia de julgamentos de sangues, e a cidade está cheia de violência.

versos.hebraico: וְהֵֽבֵאתִי֙ רָעֵ֣י גוֹיִ֔ם וְיָרְשׁ֖וּ אֶת־בָּֽתֵּיהֶ֑ם וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי֙ גְּא֣וֹן עַזִּ֔ים וְנִחֲל֖וּ מְקַֽדְשֵׁיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: Therefore I will bring the worst of the nations, and they shall possess their houses: I will also make the pride of the strong to cease; and their holy places shall be profaned.
controles.kjv: Wherefore I will bring the worst of the heathen, and they shall possess their houses: I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease; and their holy places shall be defiled.
controles.livre: Por isso farei vir os mais malignos das nações, que tomarão posse de suas casas; e farei cessar a arrogância dos poderosos,  e seus santuários serão profanados.

versos.hebraico: קְפָ֖דָה־בָ֑א וּבִקְשׁ֥וּ שָׁל֖וֹם וָאָֽיִן׃

controles.web: Destruction comes; and they shall seek peace, and there shall be none.
controles.kjv: Destruction cometh; and they shall seek peace, and there shall be none.
controles.livre: A aflição  está vindo; e buscarão a paz, porém não haverá.

versos.hebraico: הֹוָ֤ה עַל־הֹוָה֙ תָּב֔וֹא וּשְׁמֻעָ֥ה אֶל־שְׁמוּעָ֖ה תִּֽהְיֶ֑ה וּבִקְשׁ֤וּ חָזוֹן֙ מִנָּבִ֔יא וְתוֹרָה֙ תֹּאבַ֣ד מִכֹּהֵ֔ן וְעֵצָ֖ה מִזְּקֵנִֽים׃

controles.web: Mischief shall come on mischief, and rumor shall be on rumor; and they shall seek a vision of the prophet; but the law shall perish from the priest, and counsel from the elders.
controles.kjv: Mischief shall come upon mischief, and rumour shall be upon rumour; then shall they seek a vision of the prophet; but the law shall perish from the priest, and counsel from the ancients.
controles.livre: Virá desastre sobre desastre, e haverá rumor sobre rumor; então buscarão visão de profeta; porém a Lei perecerá do sacerdote, e também o conselho dos anciãos.

versos.hebraico: הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ יִתְאַבָּ֗ל וְנָשִׂיא֙ יִלְבַּ֣שׁ שְׁמָמָ֔ה וִידֵ֥י עַם־הָאָ֖רֶץ תִּבָּהַ֑לְנָה מִדַּרְכָּ֞ם אֶעֱשֶׂ֤ה אוֹתָם֙ וּבְמִשְׁפְּטֵיהֶ֣ם אֶשְׁפְּטֵ֔ם וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ

controles.web: The king shall mourn, and the prince shall be clothed with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled: I will do to them after their way, and according to their own judgments will I judge them; and they shall know that I am Yahweh.
controles.kjv: The king shall mourn, and the prince shall be clothed with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled: I will do unto them after their way, and according to their deserts will I judge them; and they shall know that I am the Lord.
controles.livre: O rei lamentará, e o príncipe se vestirá de assolamento, e as mãos do povo da terra serão atemorizadas; conforme seu caminho farei com eles, e com os seus juízos os julgarei; e saberão que eu sou o SENHOR.
